title: Concrete ordered Cech sections and their augmented mapping fibre
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $I\subset A$ an ideal, $r\geq0$, and $f:\operatorname{Fin}(r)\to A$. Let $U=\operatorname{Spec}A\setminus V(I)$ as in [def-weil-pbc-ring-complex-godement-construction], and let $V_i=U\cap D(f_i)$. Use the ordered Cech module complex of [def-sc-alternating-cech-total-complex] for $\mathcal O_U$, restrict its global-section scalars along $A\to\Gamma(U,\mathcal O_U)$, and place it on the one-object ring site of [def-weil-pbc-ring-complex-cech-data]. Denote the resulting nonnegative complex by $L_f$. The actual restriction $A\to L_f^0$ is killed by the first differential, by cancellation of the two restrictions on each pair. Thus it defines $\rho_f:A[0]\to L_f$. Define $C_f=\operatorname{Cone}(\rho_f)[-1]$ and $a_f:C_f\to A[0]$ using the first object and morphism of the inverse-rotated cone triangle. No object is selected from an existence theorem. If $\operatorname{span}(f)=I$, the family $(V_i)$ covers $U$, including the empty family when $U$ is empty.
